product.title: Chicago Odyssey Fireworks Dinner Cruise

description.text: Experience a premium fireworks dinner cruise on Lake Michigan with Chicago skyline views aboard Odyssey, with plated dining and live entertainment. The evening includes a multi-course meal, live entertainment, and a front-row seat to Navy Pier fireworks when scheduled. Floor-to-ceiling windows and outdoor decks frame Willis Tower and the Loop as the city lights up. This special-occasion outing suits couples and groups who want a full dinner experience on the water.

highlights: Fireworks dinner cruise aboard Odyssey on Lake Michigan
Navy Pier fireworks viewing when scheduled
Skyline views from indoor and outdoor decks

start.description: Board Odyssey at the Navy Pier or Chicago Harbor terminal confirmed on your reservation. Arrive 30 minutes early.

end.description: Disembark at the same terminal after the fireworks and dinner service conclude.
